sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Aeon Must Die!** is a sci-fi beat 'em up with an anime-inspired look. You play a betrayed emperor out for revenge, in fast fights where taking risks pays off. Expect flashy combos, neon lights and a lot of enemies to punch.

sections.title: MY ROLE
sections.content: I was part of the **QA team** at Focus Entertainment during the final months of the project. I helped get the game ready for release: running test plans and TRC/XR checks, **reporting bugs in Jira**, then checking their fixes.

sections.title: TESTING SCOPE
sections.content: Most of my time went into **platform compliance**: checking the game against PlayStation and Xbox requirements until it passed certification. I also **played through the game** from start to finish, logging bugs and sharing feedback along the way.
